record.question:
A ladder 15 m long reaches a window which is 9 m above the ground on one side of a street. Keeping
       its foot at the same point, the ladder is turned to the other side of the street to reach a window 12 m high.
       The width of the street is:
record.explanation: Horizontal distances are √(15²−9²)=12 m and √(15²−12²)=9 m. Width=12+9=21 m.
